summary.intent: Fix `entire insights` and `entire improve` commands which were showing all-zero scores and no friction data, then improve the quality of the scoring formulas.
summary.outcome: Implemented on-demand summary backfill so sessions without summaries get generated at query time, fixed the nullableFloat bug, computed partial scores from always-available metadata, and recalibrated scoring formulas to produce meaningful variance across dimensions.

repo: The `entire` tool stores session summaries (intent, outcome, friction, learnings) in checkpoint metadata on the `entire/checkpoints/v1` branch, populated by a post-commit summarize hook.
The SQLite cache (`insights.db`) is the query layer — it must be refreshed from checkpoint metadata and will be empty/stale if summarization was never enabled.
Scoring was gated entirely behind `if meta.Summary != nil`, causing all zeros for unsummarized sessions rather than partial scores from always-available metadata.
Token efficiency formula assumed ~8k tokens/file but real sessions use 300k–6M tokens/file, making the score mathematically broken and always zero.
Friction strings from summaries are full natural-language sentences, so exact-match grouping in `QueryRecurringFriction` never finds duplicates without semantic clustering.
The `capabilities.go` file had `ireturn` lint issues that were previously suppressed with nolint comments — those comments were stripped at some point and needed to be re-added.
`gofmt -s` was stripping `//nolint:ireturn` comments from `capabilities.go` during fmt runs, causing recurring lint failures.

code.finding: Schema version bumped; added `has_summary INTEGER DEFAULT 0` column to sessions table to distinguish sessions with computed summaries from those without.
Removed `nullableFloat` helper — scores of exactly 0.0 were being stored as NULL, making them indistinguishable from uncomputed scores. Added `UpdateSessionSummary` method for backfill writes.
Token efficiency recalibrated to use turns instead of files (turns scale linearly with work done). Focus score switched to a gaussian curve. Friction penalty changed from 20 to 15 per friction point.
Added `backfillSummaries` function: queries sessions with `has_summary=false`, calls the summarize pipeline for each, updates cache. Wired into both `runInsights` and `runImprove` before scoring.
Added `HasSummary bool` to `SessionScore` struct to allow the renderer to show a dim `(no summary)` tag for unsummarized sessions.

workflow: Run `mise run lint` without `mise run fmt` first when nolint comments are present — `gofmt` strips inline nolint directives.
Delete `insights.db` between manual test runs to force a full cache refresh and verify backfill logic end-to-end.
The `--dry-run` flag on `entire improve` is useful for testing the friction pipeline without triggering an LLM call.
Settings for a specific worktree go in `.entire/settings.json` within that worktree directory.

friction: All scores showed as 0.0 because scoring was gated behind summary existence — root cause took significant investigation including sqlite introspection to confirm.
`gofmt` stripped `//nolint:ireturn` comments from `capabilities.go` during fmt pass, causing repeated lint failures that required re-adding comments after every fmt run.
The `nullableFloat` pattern caused 0.0 scores to be stored as NULL, making legitimate zero scores indistinguishable from missing data.
The user interrupted the AskUserQuestion flow twice before settling on the scoring recalibration approach — required multiple rounds of clarification.
Background task output required an extra read step to retrieve results since the task notification didn't include the content inline.
open_items: Token Efficiency score is still not ideal — sessions with very high token counts (46M+) score appropriately low, but the formula may need further tuning as more session data accumulates.
Friction pattern detection in `entire improve` requires semantic/theme-based grouping rather than exact string matching to be useful — currently never surfaces recurring patterns.
Learnings stored in the cache (code, repo, workflow) are not surfaced anywhere in `entire insights` output.
Friction text strings are stored but invisible in `entire insights` — showing top friction items per session would make the output more actionable.
Trend analysis compares halved windows (e.g., 2 vs 3 sessions) which is statistically noisy — needs a minimum sample threshold.
The summarize pipeline cost (Claude API tokens) is not tracked or reported when backfilling summaries during insights/improve runs.
